info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Enterprises API

items.docs: Returns all enterprises within scope of the `Access Token`, optionally filtered by enterprise identifiers and external identifiers. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
